learn: Computational thinking has four big ideas: decomposition, pattern recognition, abstraction and algorithms.
Decomposition breaks a problem down. Patterns show what repeats. Abstraction keeps the important parts. Algorithms give the steps.
These ideas help with any problem, not just computers.

learn: A flowchart is a picture of an algorithm.
Ovals show start and end. Rectangles show steps. Diamonds show yes or no questions.

learn: Pseudocode is writing an algorithm in plain words that look like code.

learn: A nested loop is a loop inside another loop.
